description: Source code for bot skill tree management in the Unvanquished game, including skill definitions, parsing, and bot skillset determination.

classes.name: botSkillTreeElement_t
classes.description: Structure representing a skill in the bot skill tree, including name, skill ID, cost, allowed teams, and prerequisites.

methods.name: G_ParseSkillsetList
methods.description: Parses a CSV string into a set of skills.

methods.name: G_ParseSkillsetListWithLevels
methods.description: Parses a CSV string with 'n:skill' pairs into a vector of level-skill pairs.

methods.name: G_SetDisabledSkillset
methods.description: Sets the disabled skillset based on CSV input.

methods.name: G_SetBaseSkillset
methods.description: Sets the base skillset levels based on CSV input.

methods.name: G_IsBaseSkillAtLevel
methods.description: Checks if a skill is available at a given level.

methods.name: G_SetSkillsetBudgetHumans
methods.description: Sets the skill point budget for human bots.

methods.name: G_SetSkillsetBudgetAliens
methods.description: Sets the skill point budget for alien bots.

methods.name: G_InitSkilltreeCvars
methods.description: Initializes console variables related to bot skillsets.

methods.name: BotPickSkillset
methods.description: Deterministically picks a skillset for a bot based on seed, skill level, and team.

methods.name: BotDetermineSkills
methods.description: Determines and returns the skill list and skillset for a bot.

methods.name: CheckBaseSkillset
methods.description: Warns if base skills have missing dependencies.
